content: ServiceNeeds The ServiceNeeds are used to provide de- tailed information what the software-component expects from the AUTOSAR Services when integrated on an actual ECU. Note that only AtomicSwComponentType s and NvBlockSwComponentType s can be connected to AUTOSAR Services.
